summary: A United States-based philanthropic foundation that makes grants internationally.

name: Reliance Foundation
summary: An India-based philanthropic organisation named as a publication collaborator in the Observer Research Foundation Annual Report 2024.

name: Mukand Ltd
summary: An Indian company named in the Observer Research Foundation Annual Report 2024.

name: AZB & Partners
summary: An Indian law firm named in the Observer Research Foundation Annual Report 2024.

name: Tally Solutions
summary: An Indian company named in the Observer Research Foundation Annual Report 2024.

name: Amnesty International India Private Limited
summary: A private limited company stated by the Enforcement Directorate to have been formed in the financial year 2013-14; searched by the Enforcement Directorate in October 2018 and named in Central Bureau of Investigation and Enforcement Directorate proceedings.

name: Indians for Amnesty International Trust
summary: A trust stated by the Enforcement Directorate to have been formed in the financial year 2012-13 and named alongside Amnesty International India Private Limited in Enforcement Directorate proceedings.

name: Amnesty International India Foundation Trust
summary: A trust named by the Enforcement Directorate as having held permission under the Foreign Contribution (Regulation) Act; may be the same entity as Amnesty International India Foundation, which agency statements name separately, and the two have not been resolved.

name: Amnesty International South Asia Foundation
summary: An entity stated in the audited financial statements of Amnesty International Limited to be a dormant entity under its control and not consolidated on grounds of immateriality.

name: Amnesty International Limited
registration_type: Company limited by guarantee without share capital
summary: A company limited by guarantee registered in England and Wales that operates as the International Secretariat of Amnesty International; not registered as a charity in England and Wales.

name: Amnesty International (United Kingdom)
summary: The United Kingdom Amnesty entity named in Enforcement Directorate statements as the remitter of funds to Indian entities; the statements do not identify which legal entity is meant, and it has not been resolved to Amnesty International Limited or to any other body.
